'''Finhead Stonebone's pirate gang''' was a loose-knit organization of [[Thief/Legends|thieves]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], and [[Gangster/Legends|gangsters]] led by [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Finhead Stonebone]].

While [[Attack on the Ithullan ore hauler|attacking]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gruna]]'s [[Gruna's ore hauler|ore hauler]], they were captured by [[Enforcer One (dreadnaught)|''Enforcer One'']] of [[Bogga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], who was paid to protect Gruna.

Bogga later [[Skirmish on Ambria|commissioned]] the Stonebone and his pirates to fetch a priceless cache of [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystals]] from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Thon]] on [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]].
